data.title: Anthropic’s landmark $1.5B copyright settlement is approved

content.basic: The final approval settles one case, but it doesn't resolve the broader issue of using copyrighted works to train AI models.

data.title: AI is more likely than humans to form biases when hiring

content.basic: The next time you apply for a job, AI may screen your résumé before any human sees it. But there’s good reason to question whether AI will judge you fairly. Researchers already know that LLMs pick up human biases from their training data. New research suggests that LLMs can also develop their own biases from…
